# HaruMusic 0.1.6

- Add shared foreground-first 512 KiB range transport for Android and desktop media playback, with bounded memory caching, two-block read-ahead, verified responses and upstream cancellation.
- Remove blocking preload waits, bound source resolution and renew stale URLs when replay fails. Honor explicit CDN expiration times.
- Fix Android embedded API recovery after WebView recreation.
- Expand Android lyrics, enable direct touch scrolling and add a dedicated lyrics view entry. Fix playback-layer background contrast and header overlap.
- Unify circular and superellipse geometry; refine floating glass edges with subtle optical highlights.
- Improve FLAC lyric tag recognition, preserve local metadata across rescans, support matching LRC imports and background catalog lyric matching.

Validation: 129 automated tests, TypeScript checks, gateway range/cancellation checks, native metadata tests and Android WebView touch/viewport checks. Public source availability and mobile network conditions can still vary.

Range scheduling principles were studied in [Salt Extend Online](https://github.com/YGHFv/Salt-Extend-Online). The Fetch transport is an independent implementation; no Java/BASS adapter is bundled.
